name: moodboard-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `moodboard` flag (pro tier). The 'Moodboard' File-menu row is gated directly by useFeature('moodboard') (FileMenu.tsx) and calls openMoodboard(), which opens a new window and document.write()s a style-board HTML (palette + finishes + a furniture tile grid + hero snapshot). window.open is intercepted (returns a stub capturing the written HTML) so the real popup never spawns. Asserts: (1) the row is absent in Simple mode, (2) present after switching to Pro, (3) clicking it produces real moodboard HTML (title + palette section), (4) a direct setFeatureFlag override back to false hides the row again while staying in Pro (proving the flag itself, not just the mode switch, gates it).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: moodboard should be OFF in Simple mode (it is pro-tier)

steps.name: assert-moodboard-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Moodboard')) throw new Error('Moodboard row visible in Simple mode File menu (should be Pro-only)'); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: assert-moodboard-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Moodboard')) throw new Error('Moodboard row missing in Pro mode File menu'); })()

steps.name: click-moodboard
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Moodboard')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Moodboard button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-html-captured
steps.failMessage: openMoodboard() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open (dynamic import/build likely failed)

steps.name: assert-moodboard-content
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!/moodboard|style board/i.test(window.__capturedHtml)) throw new Error('Moodboard HTML missing expected title/section text'); })()

steps.name: assert-moodboard-hidden-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Moodboard')) throw new Error('Moodboard row still visible after direct setFeatureFlag(moodboard, false) while staying in Pro'); })()
